title: DD: forbidden deps + rules.toml [constraints]
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Add a third DD maintained view: forbidden dependency enforcement. Parse `.sutra/rules.toml` `[constraints]` section (glob-based `from`/`to` patterns). Check graph edges against rules, report violations as structural constraint violations (zero false positives). Introduces the rules.toml parser module (shared with FCA suppressions later).

Example config:
```toml
[constraints]
forbidden_deps = [
  { from = "src/tools/*", to = "src/daemon.rs" },
]
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.sutra/rules.toml` `[constraints]` section parsed correctly
- [ ] Glob patterns in `from`/`to` match file paths
- [ ] `query_forbidden_deps(rules)` returns violations for edges that match forbidden patterns
- [ ] Clean graph produces no violations
- [ ] Delta update: adding a forbidden edge triggers new violation
- [ ] Tests: fixture with known violations, clean graph, glob edge cases

## Blocked by

- sutra/v1/8 — DD engine: cycle detection + lazy population + eviction

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — verdict: needs-attention

Findings:
- [high] Malformed forbidden-dependency globs disable rules silently (src/dd/engine.rs:184-190). Pattern::new(...).ok()? inside filter_map drops invalid globs without error. A typo in rules.toml silently disables enforcement.
- [medium] Warm-up failure loses the loaded graph (src/dd/engine.rs:272-285). Shared finding with v1/9 — ensure_warm state transition can lose edge set on worker failure.

Recommendation: Fail closed on invalid constraint glob patterns (return error identifying the bad rule). Add tests asserting malformed globs fail closed.

messages.text: Review fix: invalid glob patterns in forbidden_deps now fail closed with an error identifying the bad rule and pattern (was silently dropped via filter_map+ok). Added test asserting malformed globs produce an error.
